title: 427. Moving Average from Data Stream

examples.explanation: Sliding windows of width 3 give means 1.0, 5.5, 14/3, 6.0.
Width 1 always averages the single newest value.

hints: Adaptation: replay the trace with a queue and a running sum instead of building a class.
Subtract the evicted value when the window is full so each mean is O(1).
Format each mean with the language default double-to-string conversion; checking allows small tolerance.
